body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Pandigital(www.pandigital.net) presented its 15.6-inch 4-in-1 display device 'Kitchen Technology Center' during CES 2009, which supports digital cookbook, digital photo frame, wireless internet and more.
